topic: Delayed gratification: we want the treat now, the result now, the next level now; the mind runs ahead to what hasn't arrived yet; we take our share in moderation when it comes, and until then we do today's work
figure: Epictetus, Stoic teacher c. 50-135 AD (Enchiridion 15: behave in life as at a banquet; when a dish comes round to you, take a moderate share; if it passes, do not hold it back; if it has not reached you yet, do not send your desire ahead to it, but wait until it comes). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request

lines: อยากกินตอนนี้ อยากเห็นผลเดี๋ยวนี้
ใจวิ่งไปก่อนตัวเสมอ
ถึงคิวเมื่อไหร่ ค่อยรับแต่พอดี
ยังไม่ถึง ก็ทำงานของวันนี้ไปก่อน
